messages.body_plain:
#奇元素為進球數，偶元素為罰球數
#假設每位球員每場比賽都會投進1顆3分球，但若該場次進球數為0，則該場無3分球進球數為0
NBA2016.Lin    <- c(6,3,5,0,4,0,4,2,5,4) #6,5,4,4,5
Score.NBA2016.Lin <- numeric(5)  # Score.NBA2016.Lin = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
for(i in 5)
{
  Count.3Point.Lin.i  <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lin[c(2*i-1)]== 0)) #判斷各場次進球數是否為0
  Score.NBA2016.Lin.i <- sum(NBA2016.Lin[c(2*i-1,2*i)]*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lin.i #計算各場次總得分
  Score.NBA2016.Lin[i]<- Score.NBA2016.Lin.i #將各場次總得分填入向量內(Score.NBA2016.Lin)
}
Score.NBA2016.Lin

#執行結果為
> Score.NBA2016.Lin
[1]  0  0  0  0 15

#預期結果為
[1]  16  11  9  11 15

請問出了甚麼問題?如何修正?

messages.subject: FSelector 的information.gain計算
messages.body_plain:
請問這個package裡的information.gain

Details裡面是寫這個說明
 information.gain is H(Class) + H(Attribute) − H(Class, Attribute)
但是不知道這個計算後的數字是怎麼經由計算(公式)的

假設
data(iris)
weights <- information.gain(Species~., iris)
print(weights)

列出
attr_importance
Sepal.Length       0.4521286
Sepal.Width        0.2672750
Petal.Length       0.9402853
Petal.Width        0.9554360

後面的4個數字的算法?

依照我所知的information.gain是G(A)=I(p,n)-E(A)
是分類前的資訊量減掉分類後的資訊量(p代表正n代表負)

messages.subject: 如何列出Game1,2,3,4,5每場比賽得分最多球員之名單
messages.subject_clean: 如何列出Game1,2,3,4,5每場比賽得分最多球員之名單
messages.body_plain:
#建立NBA球員的進球、罰球向量資料(3人)

#奇元素為進球數，偶元素為罰球數

NBA2016.Lin    <- c(6,3,5,0,4,0,4,2,6,4) #6,5,4,4,5

NBA2016.Booker <- c(6,4,6,1,3,0,1,1,2,0) #6,6,3,1,2

NBA2016.Lopez  <- c(6,1,3,4,12,4,8,7,4,0)#6,3,12,8,4

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

#計算3位NBA球員的總得分與平均得分

#假設每位球員每場比賽都會投進1顆3分球，但若該場次進球數為0，則該場無3分球進球數為0

# --- Lin

Count.3Point.Lin <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lin[c(1,3,5,7,9)]== 0))

Total.Score.Lin <- sum(NBA2016.Lin*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lin

Average.Score.Lin <- Total.Score.Lin/5

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Booker

Count.3Point.Booker <- sum(!(NBA2016.Booker[c(1,3,5,7,9)]== 0))

Total.Score.Booker <- sum(NBA2016.Booker*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Booker

Average.Score.Booker <- Total.Score.Booker/5

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Lopez

Count.3Point.Lopez <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lopez[c(1,3,5,7,9)]== 0))

Total.Score.Lopez <- sum(NBA2016.Lopez*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lopez

Average.Score.Lopez <- Total.Score.Lopez/5

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

#計算3位NBA球員的進球總數與得分總數

# --- 3位NBA球員進球總數

Total5.Count.Nets <- sum(NBA2016.Lin+NBA2016.Booker+NBA2016.Lopez+NBA2016.Bog+NBA2016.Kil)

# --- 5位NBA球員得分總數

Total5.Score.Nets <- Total.Score.Lin+Total.Score.Booker+

                                 Total.Score.Lopez+Total.Score.Bog+Total.Score.Kil

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

#列出每場比賽得分最多的球員

# --- Lin

NBA2016.Lin    <- c(6,3,5,0,4,0,4,2,6,4) #6,5,4,4,6

Score.Lin <- numeric(5) # Score.Lin = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

for(i in 1:5)

{

  Count.3Point.Lin.i  <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lin[c(2*i-1)]== 0)) #判斷各場次進球數是否為0

  Score.Lin.i <- sum(NBA2016.Lin[c(2*i-1,2*i)]*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lin.i #計算各場次總得分

  Score.Lin[i]<- Score.Lin.i #將各場次總得分填入向量內(Score.Lin)

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Booker

NBA2016.Booker <- c(6,4,6,1,3,0,1,1,2,0) #6,6,3,1,2

Score.Booker <- numeric(5) # Score.Booker = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

for(i in 1:5)

{

  Count.3Point.Booker.i  <- sum(!(NBA2016.Booker[c(2*i-1)]== 0)) #判斷各場次進球數是否為0

  Score.Booker.i <- sum(NBA2016.Booker[c(2*i-1,2*i)]*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Booker.i #計算各場次總得分

  Score.Booker[i]<- Score.Booker.i #將各場次總得分填入向量內(Score.Booker)

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Lopez

NBA2016.Lopez  <- c(6,1,3,4,12,4,8,7,4,0)#6,3,12,8,4

Score.Lopez <- numeric(5) # Score.Lopez = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

for(i in 1:5)

{

  Count.3Point.Lopez.i  <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lopez[c(2*i-1)]== 0)) #判斷各場次進球數是否為0

  Score.Lopez.i <- sum(NBA2016.Lopez[c(2*i-1,2*i)]*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lopez.i #計算各場次總得分

  Score.Lopez[i]<- Score.Lopez.i #將各場次總得分填入向量內(Score.Lopez)

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

#用function rbind()建立矩陣

Score.Starting.Nets <- rbind(Score.Lin,Score.Booker,Score.Lopez)

colnames(Score.Starting.Nets) <- c("Game1","Game2","Game3","Game4","Game5")

rownames(Score.Starting.Nets) <- c("Lin","Booker","Lopez")

#找出每場比賽得分最高之球員

Game1.max <- which.max(Score.Starting.Nets[,1])

Game2.max <- which.max(Score.Starting.Nets[,2])

Game3.max <- which.max(Score.Starting.Nets[,3])

Game4.max <- which.max(Game.Score.Starting[,4])

Game5.max <- which.max(Game.Score.Starting[,5])

#列出每場比賽得分最高之球員

print("The max score player in Game 1 is",Game.max_1)

Game1.max

print("The max score player in Game 2 is")

Game2.max

print("The max score player in Game 3 is")

Game3.max

print("The max score player in Game 4 is")

Game4.max

print("The max score player in Game 5 is")

Game5.max

#以上為程式碼，執行結果如下

> print("The max score player in Game 1 is",Game.max_1)

[1] "The max score player in Game 1 is"

> Game1.max

Booker

> print("The max score player in Game 2 is")

[1] "The max score player in Game 2 is"

> Game2.max

Booker

> print("The max score player in Game 3 is")

可以使用paste(), 另外你的變數太多了, 我這裡用sapply一次算五場比賽的得分王,並存成向量.

paste("The max score player in Game ",3," is    : ", row.names(Score.Starting.Nets)[Game.max[3]], sep="")
